summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share repurchase. On 8 May 2026, it bought 257,332 ordinary shares at an average price of 11.4959 GBP per share (range 11.3850–11.6150 GBP) via JP Morgan Securities under a buyback program authorized at the 2025 AGM. The company will cancel the repurchased shares, reducing share count to 2,518,736,115. This is an on-market buyback under UK and Hong Kong rules. No fixed termination date or premium is specified. Watch for continued weekly repurchase reports and the impact on EPS and capital return to shareholders; risk-arb is minimal.
